# BitRecruit

> BitRecruit is a demonstration IT job board by Dawid Olko: developer roles filterable by technology, seniority and salary. It is a frontend-only static site built with Next.js and mock data, so the listings are not real vacancies.

## Pages

- [Job offers](https://bitrecruit.dawidolko.pl/): the offer list with filters, sorting and pagination

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer who built this site
